scenes.text: Can you teach a language model a new skill by only deleting some of its weights, or by solving one equation?
scenes.say: Can you teach a language model a new skill by only deleting some of its weights? Or by solving a single equation?

scenes.headline: How to change a model by deleting weights
scenes.sub: And by solving one matrix in closed form
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fennimore! Two ways to teach a language model a skill without ordinary fine-tuning. One deletes weights. The other solves one matrix.

scenes.title: How a weight matrix can move
scenes.sub: Every method is W plus a change
scenes.say: Chapter one. How a weight matrix can move.

scenes.title: Four shapes of update
scenes.say: Every post-training method replaces a weight matrix with the matrix plus a change. They differ in what that change may be.

items.say: Full fine-tuning lets every entry move anywhere, by gradient descent.
LoRA trains a low-rank update. Small to train, but merged in, every entry moves a little.
A closed-form edit treats an MLP as a key-value store, and solves for the change directly.
And deletion: every changed entry goes to exactly zero. The only freedom is which ones.

scenes.title: Deletion Tuning
scenes.sub: Learn which weights to zero, ship a bitmask

scenes.text: Keep every pretrained weight. Learn only which gate weights to set to zero, and ship that choice as a bitmask.
scenes.mark: which gate weights to set to zero
scenes.say: Deletion Tuning keeps every pretrained weight, and learns only which gate weights to set to zero.

steps.say: Freeze a pretrained model. The target is one matrix per block, the MLP's gate projection.
Every gate weight gets a logit. A steep sigmoid of it multiplies the weight, so the weight is kept or nearly zero.
steps.term: Gate logit: one trainable number per weight

steps.say: The usual loss, from reinforcement learning or labels, sends gradients only to the logits. The weights never change.
The sigmoid sharpens into a step. What ships is one bit per weight.

params.g: logits G: shaded keep, blue delete
curve: soft mask: sigmoid of sharpness times G
deployed: keep where G is above zero
params.bits: what ships: one bit per weight
legend: Every weight gets its own logit
The layer uses W times a soft mask
Training moves logits; the sigmoid steepens
Below zero: that weight is deleted

steps.say: Here is a toy gate matrix. The pretrained weights are frozen. Beside them, one trainable logit per weight, most just above zero.
The layer uses each weight times a sigmoid of its logit. Early in training that mask is soft.
The loss moves the logits, and the sharpness ramps up, until the sigmoid is a step. A logit that ends below zero has deleted its weight.
What ships is one bit per weight. The pretrained weights never changed.
Llama three point two, one billion, has about two hundred sixty-eight million gate weights.
The logits start from a pruning score. The lowest-scoring sliver starts on the delete side.
Random noise in the other logits puts about three hundred sixty-two thousand more below zero at step zero.
The published mask deletes five hundred fifty-seven thousand. Under GRPO the count barely moves from where the starting values put it. Training chooses which bits flip.

scenes.title: Llama 3 8B on GSM8K, GRPO
scenes.note: A tie: the lead is four problems
scenes.say: On Llama 3 8B under GRPO, it matches full fine-tuning: eighty-three point five five against eighty-three point two four. The lead is four problems. A tie.

steps.say: Forward KL from the base model, on the smallest Llama. The mask stays flat near zero while every other method climbs.
Accuracy on six older tasks. The mask stays within a point of the base; the others drift down.

scenes.title: One solve, no steps
scenes.sub: A decision skill written into one matrix
scenes.say: Chapter three. One solve, no steps.

scenes.title: Where the edit goes in Qwen3.5-0.8B

steps.say: A blog post from embedding dot in moves a teacher's decisions into a small model. It edits the down projection of the MLP in the last layers.
Only two hundred fifty-six neurons, the ones most active at the answer position.
That is a block of two hundred sixty-two thousand weights.
Found by one solve, in three point one milliseconds.

scenes.title: The other edit: one solve, no steps
scenes.text: ΔW = Rᵀ K (Kᵀ K + λ n C)⁻¹

parts.note: what 256 neurons see, and what the teacher wants
parts.say: Keys are what the chosen neurons output at the answer. Values are how the final state must change to match a teacher's answer.
This term protects ordinary text: it penalises any change in what the layer writes there.

parts.note: one linear solve, written into one matrix
parts.say: Set the gradient to zero, and the best edit is one linear solve. No steps, no learning rate.

scenes.label: WikiText perplexity when the protection term is dropped
scenes.say: Drop the protection term, and the same solve still hits its targets. But perplexity goes to ten to the eleventh. The protection term is the method.

scenes.title: Read at their sample sizes
scenes.say: Chapter four. Read at their sample sizes.

scenes.title: What the headlines leave out
scenes.say: The article checked both posts against their own numbers.

items.say: The edit post's eighteen percent baseline says no to everything. Always saying yes would score about eighty-two.
Its damage check, one prompt hurt against five for LoRA, is fifteen prompts. Not yet a difference.
And Deletion Tuning's fewer than zero point zero five percent holds for seven of eight GRPO masks, none of the supervised ones.

scenes.label: Reworded questions answered right
scenes.say: And reworded, the same questions get five of eleven right from the edited model, eight from the unedited one. There is no sign the skill survives a new wording.

scenes.text: Few changed weights is a side effect. Old skills survive when the edit is chosen by the task and anchored.
